name: Robert Brodie
bio:
Robert Brodie, is an actor based in Sydney, Australia. Standing at 4'3", with a dynamic range and a unique on-screen presence, Robert continues to built a diverse portfolio of work across film and television.

His credits include an appearance on Hughesy, We Have a Problem (2018), multiple short and feature length films, and has also shared the screen with cast members from Talk to Me (2022), Thor: Love and Thunder (2022) and the iconic Australian TV series, Home and Away (1988).

Known for his dedication and versatility, Robert brings depth and authenticity to every role, making him an exciting talent within the industry.

credits.title: Echo 8 Beyond
credits.overview: After the occurrences of 'Echo 8,' Anna finds herself pursued by lethal Zodiac operatives tasked with her termination. Living off-grid, she shields her mother from a distance. However, her identity is exposed when she crosses paths with a group of misfits.

credits.title: INFINIT3
credits.overview: In the liminal space between life and death, Lucy wanders through the fractured memories of her past in search of peace.

credits.title: Armstrong
credits.overview: A country bloke moves to Sydney with high hopes for a new life, we follow him through the course of 24 hours as he goes through a series of unfortunate events which ends with him being hospitalised and fighting for his life.
